name: Djeru
description: Djeru is an initiate and leader of the Tah crop on Amonkhet and Samut's childhood friend, who later became Hazoret's loyal lieutenant.

description_citations.text: "Samut", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Djeru is an initiate and leader of the Tah crop on Amonkhet and Samut's childhood friend, who later became Hazoret's loyal lieutenant.

citations.text: "Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: As a child he was close to Samut and Nakht, showing them a hole in the Hekma, and after the trespass into the desert cost Nakht his life, the loss hardened Djeru's faith.

citations.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.
"Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.
"Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

bio.text: As an initiate he led his crop through the Trial of Ambition, drowning Meris and cutting out his heart for Bontu's toll.

citations.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.
"Djeru", section "Trial of Ambition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the final Trial of Zeal Samut fought beside him and tackled him away from Hazoret's spear, and Gideon's shield blocked it, denying him the glorious death he wanted.

citations.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

bio.text: When the Hours began and the Gate opened onto wastes, Hazoret called him her final champion and ordered him to protect others, and he lost faith, declaring the God-Pharaoh lied.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
Djeru's Renunciation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He stood with Samut against the God-Pharaoh, helped bring down the Scorpion God, and knelt to Hazoret as she led the survivors into the desert.

citations.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.
"Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.
"Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

bio.text: In the Phyrexian invasion he became Hazoret's lieutenant, and when she ignited the Phyrexians' oil he led elite fighters to dismember them.

citations.text: "Djeru", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Djeru", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Alive as of the latest story, where he goes with Samut and Hazoret on Amonkhet as the worlds begin to overlay.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Djeru tells Samut they must leave the unworthy behind.
timeline.quote: We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut.

citation.text: Baleful Ammit (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Djeru shows a cursed minotaur as a warning of what awaits those who fail.
timeline.quote: That is what awaits us if we fail.

citation.text: Cursed Minotaur (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon shields Djeru from Hazoret, who prophesies that he will die by immortal hands.
timeline.quote: Hazoret prophesied to him that he would die by immortal hands

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut watches her friend Nakht wither and die in the desert.
timeline.quote: Samut watched one of her best friends die

citation.text: "Samut", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut tries to convince Djeru not to enter the Trial of Zeal.
timeline.quote: She tried to convince him not to go to the final trial; the Trial of Zeal .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut fights beside Djeru in the arena.
timeline.quote: Samut ran to Djeru's side, and the two fought back to back, Samut's only goal being Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut tackles Djeru away from Hazoret's spear and Gideon shields them, denying Djeru his death.
timeline.quote: Gideon intervened at the same moment, protecting the pair of them from Hazoret with his invulnerability.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut, Djeru and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oketra tells Gideon this is where the Trials begin, then leaves him with the initiate Djeru, who greets him as a friend.
timeline.quote: I am Djeru of the Tah crop.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru spars with Gideon and wins, then introduces him to the crop.
timeline.quote: You're good. You could be better. Come.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns that crops lose members through the Trials, and Djeru's crop is replacing one lost the day before.
timeline.quote: Many other crops are culled significantly from Trial to Trial, and reformed with others.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Meris names the lost dissenter Samut, angering Djeru, who explains she chose heresy and was removed; Gideon recalls seeing a woman shouting that the gods lie.
timeline.quote: She is a dissenter ,

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Dedi wades into a filth pool to turn a crank that raises a bridge, but acid filth floods the chamber and dissolves him as the crop flees; one initiate is lost.
timeline.quote: skin and flesh sloughed off his forearm, revealing bone.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Tausret insist the crop press on, calling Dedi's death glorious, which disturbs Gideon.
timeline.quote: Dedi died a glorious death.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru rebukes Gideon for treating each glorious death as a tragedy and sends the crop through a corridor of bladed pendulums in order of speed.
timeline.quote: What is wrong with you?

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The ammit chases the last runners into the corridor and a blade kills Setha.
timeline.quote: a rogue blade reduced Setha to a black and red smear of viscera.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon uses his golden shield to smash through the swinging blades, disabling the trap, and Djeru grows suspicious of his abilities.
timeline.quote: The first one smashed into me, shattering and launching me into the wall

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Four initiates volunteer to stand on pillars to open the door while holding the ammit and monsters; Djeru swaps Masika for Tausret and the four are left behind.
timeline.quote: Masika. I need you to switch with Tausret.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon is rebuked for wanting to stay and the crop leaves the four to die.
timeline.quote: Where is your ambition?

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The nine survivors reach Bontu's summit chamber, having lost Imi to scarabs, and Bontu displays a scale at a bridge across serpent-filled water.
timeline.quote: We were now nine.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu announces her toll of one heart from each, saying the initiates' numbers are too great.
timeline.quote: Pay the toll, or fall short and perish.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Meris and Djeru choose not to fight; Djeru embraces Meris and then drowns him in the serpent pool, cutting out his heart for the toll.
timeline.quote: Then he shoved him into the water.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Gideon's strength with her gaze and commands him to watch while Djeru finishes the killing.
timeline.quote: Watch, Kytheon Iora. Quiet your judgment, and learn.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon furiously denounces the slaughter and dives across to confront Bontu, who calls him brazen and ignorant of her world.
timeline.quote: What mockery of faith and divinity is this madness?

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: On the eve of their Harvest, Samut finds Nakht by the river and the friends play-fight, joined by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Samut gave him a playful shove, sending him stumbling back into the water

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The trio sneaks out of the Children's Quarters at night, and Nakht reveals he can command water.
timeline.quote: a small gush of water swirled sprang from the fountain and danced around his fingertips.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leads her friends to an old mural of Hazoret and strange fighting forms, which she performs.
timeline.quote: Samut assumed the first stance on the mural

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nakht wonders aloud whether there was a time before the gods, unsettling his friends.
timeline.quote: if there ever was a time before the gods.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru shows his secret, a hole in the Hekma, and Nakht persuades the others to go out and look for themselves.
timeline.quote: working his way through the near-invisible hole in the Hekma

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The three children crawl through the barrier into the desert wastes.
timeline.quote: then dropped to her belly and began crawling through to the other side.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In the desert they find a half-buried statue and ruins, and a gigantic limbed thing in the distance sends them fleeing.
timeline.quote: a looming . . . thing shuffled across the sand.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a ruined shrine they find the word Trespasser freshly carved beneath the God-Pharaoh's symbol.
timeline.quote: Trespasser.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Rotting corpses rise from the oasis and swarm the shrine, which Djeru calls dissenters returned by the curse of wandering.
timeline.quote: From the stagnant water and the surrounding sands, rotting corpses started to rise.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nakht draws the risen away and conjures a whirlpool to hold them while Samut and Djeru escape.
timeline.quote: The stagnant waters beneath him swirled into a whirlpool

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut sees Nakht wither to a lifeless husk, and Djeru tackles her out of sight; they flee back to the city at dawn.
timeline.quote: She heard his soul-rending screech as he instantly withered and decayed

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Years later, the loss hardens Djeru's faith while Samut takes up doubt and searches the ancient parts of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: took up the mantle of doubt and questions

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut hides in an old embalming chamber after fleeing viziers and the anointed, and meets Djeru, who came disguised as a mummy.
timeline.quote: The wholesome face of her friend Djeru emerged

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut begs Djeru not to enter the final Trial, claiming the God-Pharaoh is a lie, but he refuses and walks out.
timeline.quote: Don't go to the final Trial.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut mentions Nakht, and Djeru angrily says Nakht died unworthy because of their foolish trespass.
timeline.quote: Nakht died unworthy , out there in the dunes, because of our stupidity.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
timeline.quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret not to take Djeru's life, and Hazoret questions her right to cage his heart.
timeline.quote: I have come to plead for Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut explains that she needs to save Djeru, believing he could convince a god they were lied to.
timeline.quote: If anyone could convince a god they'd been lied to, it's him.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
timeline.quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The battle magic fades, and Djeru surrenders his khopesh and prays for Samut's glorified death.
timeline.quote: Djeru concluded with his khopesh on the ground, a formal surrender.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret asks Djeru to claim his place, and he accepts, but Samut declines Hazoret's gift.
timeline.quote: Without hesitation, she shook her head.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
timeline.quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru, enraged that his chance at a glorious death is gone, beats on Gideon and weeps that he wants to exist.
timeline.quote: Because I want to exist!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
timeline.quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
timeline.quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Djeru to promise to protect their gods and each other.
timeline.quote: No matter what happens, we protect our gods. We protect each other.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun reaches its final point and the Gate cracks open, then swings wide to reveal endless wastes instead of paradise.
timeline.quote: What lay beyond the Gate were endless, empty wastes.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: A winged demon flies through the Gate and perches on an obelisk, and Samut recognizes it.
timeline.quote: Demons were rare on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Djeru whether he still believes the God-Pharaoh is benevolent, and Djeru's doubt grows.
timeline.quote: Do you still believe this is the act of a benevolent God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra takes Samut and Djeru onto Tuya as they seek to protect Oketra.
timeline.quote: The two former initiates gracefully climbed atop Tuya

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
timeline.quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra weeps for her gods, then tells Gideon the source of the hell is his responsibility to kill.
timeline.quote: Then he is your responsibility to kill.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
timeline.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
timeline.quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru loses faith, declaring the God-Pharaoh lied.
timeline.quote: Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.

citation.text: Djeru's Renunciation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut urges Djeru to lead people out of the city.
timeline.quote: We have to get out of the city, Djeru.

citation.text: Crash Through (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru reunite and rally surviving initiates against the Scorpion God and the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Rallying as many surviving initiates as they could, they fought back against the Scorpion God and the Eternal horde.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The living bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk; Hazoret vows to stand by the mortals.
timeline.quote: the living managed to bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in the Phyrexians' veins and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru publicly declares he stands with Samut against the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: I have seen more than I needed to realize she speaks truth.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut resolves to go back into the city to protect Hazoret, and Djeru and other warriors join her while Hapatra stays to guide the survivors into the sands.
timeline.quote: I am Rhonas's broken fang, and I know where to strike to stop the undead and the monstrosities in their tracks.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru fight the Eternal Neheb the Worthy and are beaten back.
timeline.quote: Neheb swung his spear forward, sending a wave of flame at Samut.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru persuades Samut to stand down and find the last god while the Gatewatch fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Find the last god of Amonkhet, protect her, and protect the people of our city.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru, guided by the young vizier Haq, find Rhonas's body and Samut rallies the survivors.
timeline.quote: We will embody the strength Rhonas taught us

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru trips the scorpion god and Samut redirects its fall so an obelisk pierces its chest.
timeline.quote: an earth-shattering crunch echoed across the battlefield as the obelisk pierced the scorpion god's chest.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
timeline.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the Phyrexians' oil with her spear while the insect gods distract them, and Djeru's fighters dismember them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex's Copper Host invades, terraforming the desert and trying to convert the dead; survivors go into hiding then strike back.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex's Copper Host was the main invasion force on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scarab and Locust Gods distract the Phyrexians while Hazoret ignites their glistening oil and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in Phyrexians' veins on Amonkhet while Djeru's fighters dismember them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Across the Multiverse the worlds begin to overlay; on Ravnica, Bloomburrow, Amonkhet and Dominaria, people see doubles of their worlds.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, the worlds begin to overlay.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru lead the people out of Naktamun into the desert.
timeline.quote: Samut and Djeru leading the people out of Naktamun into the desert

citation.text: "Amonkhet block/Trivia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Djeru, once best friends with Samut and Nakht, becomes a devout follower of the Gods and estranged from Samut after Nakht's death.
timeline.quote: After the death of Nakht outside the Hekma , he became a devout follower of the Gods and estranged from Samut.

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Djeru survives Bontu's Trial of Ambition.
timeline.quote: Djeru survived Bontu 's Trial of Ambition , despite the bumbling actions of Gideon Jura .

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Trial of Ambition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut appeals to Hazoret, and she and the Gatewatch are forced to fight the Trial of Zeal against Djeru.
timeline.quote: Samut appealed to Hazoret to stop Djeru from taking the last Trial.

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut joins forces with Djeru and prevents his death with Hazoret's spear, though he does not appreciate it.
timeline.quote: In a surprise move Samut managed to join forces with Djeru, convincing him to pray for her life to Hazoret.

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Djeru, Samut and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Joining forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret commands them to protect survivors; Djeru and Samut return and save Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
timeline.quote: they returned to the damaged city and were able to save Hazoret from her fight with the Scorpion God .

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Joining forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Survivors hide from the Phyrexian invasion in vain, then plan a counterattack relying on Hazoret with Djeru as lieutenant.
timeline.quote: with Djeru as her loyal lieutenant.

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Naktamun the survivors find the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting the invaders.
timeline.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders.

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the Phyrexians' oil and Djeru leads elite fighters to dismember them; the insect gods then depart.
timeline.quote: Djeru led a crop of elite fighters to dismember them, making sure they were out of the picture for good.

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut, Djeru and their band encountered Haq, who joined them and told of Bontu's betrayal and the God-Pharaoh's cruelty.
timeline.quote: He had witnessed the battle between Bontu and Hazoret

citation.text: "Haqikah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Haq guided the group past the fallen god Rhonas, where they mourned and resolved to fight.
timeline.quote: leading them past the fallen god Rhonas

citation.text: "Haqikah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret appeared, injured and pursued by the Scorpion God; the survivors battled it and Hazoret reduced the god to ash.
timeline.quote: Hazoret delivered the final blow, reducing the god to ash.

citation.text: "Haqikah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Djeru led elite fighters to dismember the Phyrexians; the insect gods then departed for the deep desert.
timeline.quote: the inscrutable insect gods departed for the deep desert without a word

citation.text: "Locust God", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the oil in the Phyrexians' veins and Djeru's fighters dismember them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins
